newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil's CSN upped to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil's CSN upped to buy.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said in a report it had upgraded its intermediate rating on Brazilian private steelmaker CSN to buy from accumulate.

-- It also said it had increased its 1997 net profit projection for the company to 290.9 million reais from 265.1 million reais and its 1998 net profit forecast to 329.8 million reais from 292.9 million reais.
-- Merrill Lynch said CSN's first quarter net profit came in at 71.6 million reais versus its estimate of 51.1 million reais.
-- It also said it views CSN's commanding presence in the consortium that last week bought a controlling stake in mining giant CVRD as positive news.
-- CSN shares were flat at 37.60 reais on the Sao Paulo bourse.
